page0.text: Soon after Fuji-nee leaves, I lock up and Sakura and I leave as well.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-09:page0:1

page1.text:
"Senpai. I won't be able to come help out from tonight until Monday. Will that be all right?"
"That's fine. Besides, it's the weekend. I bet you have friends to hang out with, so don't worry about me."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-09:page1:1

page2.text:
"Eh... Oh, no that's not it! It really is for personal reasons, so I'm still going to practice at the club! S-so if you need anything just come to the dojo and I'll figure things out!
And I'm not going to go out just because it's the weekend. So...um...please don't get the wrong idea!"
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-09:page2:1

page3.text:
"What?"
Sakura's acting suspicious, or rather, she seems nervous.
I don't know why, but it's probably just that she can't come over the weekend.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-09:page3:1

page4.text:
"Got it. I'll go to the dojo if I need anything."
"Yes. That would be great."
Sakura sighs in relief.
But the moment Sakura lowers her gaze, her expression stiffens.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-09:page4:1

page5.text:
"Senpai, your hand."
"Hm?"
Sakura is staring at my left hand.
I look down and see blood trickling from it.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-09:page5:1

page6.text:
"Huh?"
I pull up my shirt sleeve.
Yep. Blood.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-09:page6:1

page7.text:
"The hell? Did I cut myself with something last night?"
But I don't feel any pain.
It looks like there's a welt on my hand...
The bruise stretches all the way from my shoulder to the back of my hand. It looks like a snake that's trying to reach my palm from the top of my shoulder.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-09:page7:1

page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-09:page8:1
